narr: Slow moving and training thunderstorms along a cold front resulted in flash flooding across part of the western Florida Panhandle.
ev: Major flooding was reported along Gulf Breeze Parkway in Gulf Breeze. A port of Da Lisa Road and the intersection of Garden Road and Commerce Road were closed near Bagdad. Flooding was also reported near the intersection of Raughton Road and Clearview Street near Garcon Point.
